say:1:1523640201:0.text: So many of the victims have fallen ill... Good thing you stepped in. If the disease had spread, Halia might have faced another disaster.
say:1:1523640201:0.source_cn: 竟然有这么多难民生病……还好有你帮忙，要是拖到疾病传播...

say:2:1523640202:1.text: I'll have the guards distribute the medicine right away. We also need to expedite the shelter construction so the victims can settle down soon...
say:2:1523640202:1.source_cn: 我这就派卫兵去给他们送药。另外，还得加快避难所的修建速...
